description: Image Description: The image features a skateboard resting on a patch of grass. The skateboard has a worn, scratched deck with a red and white design. The wheels and trucks are visible, with the wheels appearing to be off the ground. The background includes a mix of grass and dirt, with some small leaves scattered around. A portion of a rock or stone can be seen on the left side, partially in the dirt area. The image is taken from an angle that looks down at the skateboard from above
